{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tweed-style blazer, single-breasted, slightly cropped to the hip, deep burgundy #7A1F32, textured wool blend
Blouse, relaxed fit with a soft bow-tie neck and long sleeves, cream #F3EAD8, silk satin
Trousers, straight-leg, high-waisted, full length to the ankle bone, dark chocolate #3B2A25, fine wool crepe
Trench coat, belted, knee-length, camel #B98B5B, water-repellent cotton gabardine
Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, dark espresso #2E1F1A, waterproof smooth leather
Structured tote bag, medium size, cognac #9A5B34, grained leather
Compact umbrella, burgundy #7A1F32, waterproof polyester
Earrings, sculptural gold hoops, warm gold #C9A24B, polished metal

This outfit sits in the neat business band, with a textured jacket, a blouse and trousers, and ankle boots, so it looks professional for a client meeting. The burgundy tweed blazer against the cream blouse is the bold note you wanted, and it stands out without becoming loud. The trench coat, waterproof boots and umbrella keep you dry through a day of rain and still look polished. The warm palette of burgundy, camel, chocolate and gold suits the autumn setting and the cozy cafe."}
